description: Seven builder stories: Meta's Muse personal agent with Secure VM, NVIDIA's open IMO-gold math pipeline, Cognition SWE-2 on Kimi K3, GitHub HydraFusion routing, Abacus Smaug agents, Salesforce long-horizon runtime, and NVIDIA PAIR local routing.
lead: Personal agents, cheaper coding models, and local compute lead the last 24 hours. Meta shipped a consumer agent that keeps working after you close the app, NVIDIA opened a gold-medal math pipeline anyone can reproduce, and Cognition squeezed frontier-adjacent coding out of an open base at much lower cost. Plus multi-model routing in Copilot, a long-horizon runtime from Salesforce, and a way to spread local inference across the machines you already own. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 13, 2026: personal agents, coding models, and local routing
